When presenting a benchmark ruling card with issue and decision.

selection.when_to_use: When two companies merge assets into a unified combined entity with share allotment.
When a partnership firm converts into a corporate company and partners receive shares.
When two parties swap distinct assets directly with cash differential balance.
When statutory authority compulsorily acquires an asset with compensation awards.
When a partner introduces an asset into a partnership firm recorded at book value.
When a company in liquidation distributes assets and cash surplus to shareholders.
When comparing two alternative values to mechanically adopt the lower value.
When valuing an asset acquired prior to cutoff date with fair market value and limit ceiling.

animations.title: Higher of Cost or Market Value

selection.when_to_use: When two valuation benchmark values are compared and the higher value is adopted, with optional limit ceiling.
When an asset cost base grows across tax years via statutory index multiplier ratio.
When cost incurred by an original owner travels across a succession chain to become the current holder cost base.
When months held by previous owner and current owner are combined to determine short or long status against statutory threshold.

animations.title: Two Taxpayers Side by Side Computation

selection.when_to_use: When two taxpayers, co-owners, or dual computation options are computed in parallel to compare net results.
When multiple improvement expenditures occur and those incurred before statutory cutoff date are excluded while post-cutoff are accepted.
When advance money is received during failed negotiations, retained upon deal cancellation, and treated as cost reduction or income.

animations.title: Flat Tax Rate & Extra Rate Total

selection.when_to_use: When taxable gains are taxed at a flat statutory rate and health cess is added on top.
When total capital gains are partitioned against an exempt threshold buffer, with only the excess above threshold subject to tax.
When an incurred capital loss pool is absorbed sequentially against eligible income heads in priority order.
